$comment: detector-task/1 (contracts 3.18.0; adapters/detector-simulation, docs/dev/detector-simulation/TASK.md 9.5): the user's intent for one detector-simulation capability run. A sidecar read by adapters/detector-simulation/assets/detsim.py, not an artifact type. No replicate (it comes only from --replicate). Every pattern is anchored and is applied again with re.fullmatch by detsim_schemas.py, because contracts/schema.py uses re.search (where $ also matches before a trailing newline). Code checks also refuse '.' and '..' path segments, a repeated input path, a float anywhere and the other hash-scope violations of detsim_canonical.check_hash_scope. Physical quantities are {value, unit} with a decimal string (see $defs/quantity); the plan carries them normalized (decimal/1).

environment_ref.description: the env_identity of a validated environment record artifacts_root/detector-simulation/.env/<env_identity>.json

parameters.description: capability parameters, validated by the capability descriptor's parameters_schema

relative_path.description: a path relative to the project root, '/'-separated, ASCII; no '.' or '..' segment (code check)

decimal.description: decimal/1 input grammar (ASCII); normalize_decimal turns it into the normalized form

unit.description: an ASCII unit symbol such as um, V/cm, cm/ns, e, or 1 for a dimensionless quantity
